stepTitle: Calculate the increase in velocity of a $$4000\, \text{kg}$$ space probe that expels $$3500\, \text{kg}$$ of its mass at an exhaust velocity of $$2.00\times10**{3}\,\text{m/s}.$$ You may assume the gravitational force is negligible at the probe’s location. Give the increase to three significant figures (in $$\text{m/s})$$.
